run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import mon_status as m; assert m.topic_of('the cost of Intune licences so far') is None and m.topic_of('how do I resume a session that is running in Claude Code?') is None and m.topic_of('what does kbmon do?') is None
